tools.name: check_launch_readiness
tools.description: Audit a product homepage before launching it: HTTPS, noindex, title and meta description, og:image (fetched to confirm it loads), X card, favicon, canonical, mobile viewport, h1, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap, parked or 404 pages, response time, and whether the page is empty without JavaScript. Retur

tools.name: recommend_launch_directories
tools.description: Hand-picked launch directories for a product type, grouped by when to submit (launch day first, evergreen after). Every pick carries a human-written verdict, including the ones that are not worth paying for, plus Ahrefs DR, link type and price. Start here; use find_launch_directories to go wider acr

tools.name: find_launch_directories
tools.description: Filter 1,666 startup, SaaS and AI directories by category, minimum Ahrefs DR, link type (dofollow/nofollow), price and badge-swap requirement. Returns submit URLs. Link type and price are "unknown" where nobody has verified them yet - treat those as unverified, not as free or dofollow.

tools.name: get_launch_directory
tools.description: Look up one directory by domain or URL: Ahrefs DR, dofollow or nofollow, price, whether it wants a badge swap, the submit URL, and a human verdict where one exists. Use it to vet a directory before paying for a listing.

tools.name: submit_project
tools.description: List a product on the SaaSCity launch directory. Creates an inert draft and returns a claim URL; the human opens it to sign in, confirm the listing and pick a launch Monday. Nothing is published or charged until they do, and every listing is reviewed by a person. Free to submit. Free subdomain hosts

tools.name: check_badge
tools.description: Check whether the SaaSCity badge is live on a site. Reads the given URL and, for a deep page, the site homepage too, rendering JavaScript if the static HTML misses it. A verified badge turns the listing link dofollow.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Where a SaaSCity submission stands: a draft by claim token (unclaimed, claimed and in review, or expired) or a live listing by slug (launch week, badge, link type, points).

tools.name: get_launch_weeks
tools.description: SaaSCity launch-week queue: the next 12 Mondays, how many free slots each has left, and which are full. Use it to tell a founder when a free listing would go live.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: SaaSCity listing offers with real prices - free queue, Quick Pass, Premium - and exactly what each buys (queue position, dofollow link, launch post). Only a human can pay, on the claim page.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search products listed on SaaSCity by keyword and/or category. Returns title, tagline, category, upvote points, the listing page and the product site. Useful for market research ("what else exists in this space?") before a launch.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One live SaaSCity listing by slug: title, tagline, full description, category, upvote points, link type (dofollow/nofollow), listing page and product site.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: SaaSCity's most upvoted launches for this week's launch, the last 30 days, or all time, optionally within one category.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Other SaaSCity listings in the same category as a given listing, most upvoted first. Useful for competitor research and positioning.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_launch_readiness, get_launch_directory, submit_project, check_badge, get_submission_status, get_offers · Private data: get_submission_status · Public sink: recommend_launch_directories, find_launch_directories, get_launch_directory, submit_project, get_offers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_launch_readiness, get_launch_directory, submit_project, check_badge, get_submission_status, get_offers · Private data: get_submission_status · Public sink: recommend_launch_directories, find_launch_directories, get_launch_directory, submit_project, get_offers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
